summary: The six frozen files consistently distinguish unauthenticated Cloudflare Access 302 interception from authenticated Worker callback reachability; bind the exact registered callback URI, matching submitted receipt hashes, and three screenshot hashes; preserve the exact two-item ordered submission with authority NONE and pending acceptance; state the required readiness counts; and avoid claims for OAuth success, enablement, acceptance, admission, credential capture, or domain/Access mutation. Privacy markers and scope boundaries are consistent.
